purpose: オープニング＆wrapUpのBEFORE。夜10時、船が着いたばかりの静かなふ頭
scene: Night at a miniature clay container wharf, 10pm: a container ship has just docked, gangway down, containers still stacked on deck. The gantry crane stands ready but idle. Floodlights are on, long soft shadows, calm dark-blue sea, a few tiny helmeted workers walking toward the ship. Quiet anticipation before work begins.
composition: Medium-wide view of the wharf from a fixed vantage point: ship on the left at the quay, crane center, empty truck lane on the right leading toward a lit gate. Same camera position will be reused for the AFTER image. Keep the crane and quay fully in frame with generous margins.
